This change is breaking for developers relying on the old tier identifiers and includes comprehensive updates to documentation and internal test infrastructure.

- Collapsed the `pro` and `team` legacy tiers into a single, unified `paid` tier. Developers integrating with tier-based logic should update their checks to reference the new `paid` tier instead of the deprecated `pro` or `team` identifiers.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Updated all public-facing and legal documentation to reflect the new `Free`, `Paid`, and `Enterprise` pricing structure, providing clarity on the simplified tier model.

### 🧹 Chores

- Refactored internal test suites to validate functionality against the new `Free`, `Paid`, and `Enterprise` tier model, ensuring system stability with the updated pricing structure.
- Bumped the application version to v2.6.0.
